verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents an official `dg` CLI that covers transcription, streaming, TTS, text analysis and account management. It has AI-native features: switchable output formats, script-friendly exit codes, auto-detection of agent environments such as Claude Code, Aider and Codex, and a built-in MCP server. A probe confirmed the CLI docs page is live. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI in agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The dg CLI lets you transcribe files, stream live audio, synthesize speech, analyze text, and manage your Deepgram account from the terminal.
The CLI auto-detects AI agent environments, including Claude Code, Aider, and OpenAI Codex, and adjusts its behavior
Most command and usage outcomes use these exit codes, so scripts and CI steps can branch on them
